messages:
alice.j: Nexa just emailed — they're asking to reprice our spot commit for the FRA dock window (W44). Also requesting depot photos as RMA evidence to process a partial credit. cc procurement

ben_p: ugh. what's the delta? PO?

alice.j: PO-8912, commit ~3k H100s. Vendor proposing +6% on base rate unless we accept a 7-day dock hold. They say they need pallet/AWB photos to validate the DOA claims. Email snapshot: https://mail.example.com/msg/abc123

clara_ops: Can we push back — accept existing price if they split expedite fee 50/50 and provide high-res pallet photos + serial manifest? :thinking_face:

nexa_ops: We can do that. If Redwood signs an addendum for the 6% increase we'll waive expedite fee. Photos required for RMA otherwise insurance declines the claim.

diego_supply: How many affected units? we can't take a price increase across entire commit.

alice.j: Estimate ~120 units in that wave (W44). Rest of the commit not impacted. Contract clause 4.2 allows repricing if carrier delays >48h but we've disputed carrier liability.

ben_p: Counter-proposal: cap repricing to impacted units only; require serial-level photo evidence uploaded to s3://redwood-procurement/rma/1742208888/ by vendor within 48h. If not provided, revert to original pricing + audit penalty.

clara_ops: Also require depot sign-off (depot_id) and manifest snippet. I'll draft addendum. :writing_hand:

nexa_ops: Accepted in principle. Template for manifest/snippet (example):
```
manifest_id: FRA-W44-001
sku: H100-PCIe
qty: 120
serials_provided: true
photos: 6
awb: DE1234567890
```
We will upload to the bucket once agreed.

alice.j: OK. Diego — can you confirm depot_id and whether they can turn around photos in 24-48h?

diego_supply: Depot FRA-DC9 can do 48h. They require 'PO-8912' on the photo filenames and a short timestamped checklist. I'll ping on-site ops contact now.

ops-bot: Reminder: create procurement ticket RN-2026 and attach addendum. /create_ticket RN-2026

ben_p: Also propose a 10% partial holdback on impacted units until serial reconciliation completes. Protects us if there are more DOAs than reported.

nexa_ops: 10% holdback is steep. Can we compromise at 5% with a strict upload SLA? We can accept 5% holdback on impacted units if photos+manifest in 48h.

alice.j: We accept 5% holdback + vendor must upload photos + manifest in 48h. Clara will draft addendum and route for signature. :thumbsup:

clara_ops: I'll include the SLA clause, S3 path, checksum/manifest validation, and an audit penalty clause (revert pricing + vendor credit) if files missing. Draft ready in ~2h.

ben_p: Finance needs to sign off on amended payment schedule — @finance please ack.

nexa_ops: Thanks — we'll start photo capture tomorrow morning (FRA local). We'll push to the agreed bucket once addendum is signed.

alice.j: Thanks everyone. I'll attach the signed addendum and update RN-2026 when done.

(attachments: email-screenshot.png, draft-addendum-v1.pdf, sample-manifest.txt)
